name: spacegate-admin
description: Full-stack hai workspace with separated contract, service and frontends.

scripts.i18n:compile: pnpm --filter spacegate-admin-shared paraglide:compile && pnpm --filter spacegate-admin-web paraglide:compile && pnpm --filter spacegate-admin-app paraglide:compile && pnpm --filter spacegate-admin-desktop paraglide:compile && pnpm --filter spacegate-admin-miniapp sync-i18n
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter spacegate-admin-contract build && pnpm i18n:compile && pnpm --parallel --filter spacegate-admin-serv --filter spacegate-admin-web --filter spacegate-admin-app --filter spacegate-admin-desktop dev
scripts.dev:test: pnpm --filter spacegate-admin-contract build && pnpm i18n:compile && pnpm --parallel --filter spacegate-admin-serv --filter spacegate-admin-web --filter spacegate-admin-app --filter spacegate-admin-desktop dev:test
scripts.dev:prod: pnpm --filter spacegate-admin-contract build && pnpm i18n:compile && pnpm --parallel --filter spacegate-admin-serv --filter spacegate-admin-web --filter spacegate-admin-app --filter spacegate-admin-desktop dev:prod
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter spacegate-admin-contract build && pnpm i18n:compile && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter spacegate-admin-contract build && pnpm i18n:compile && pnpm -r --if-present test
